title: Grounded Adjudication of Variations across Extracted TimeLines (GAVEL): Comparing Clinical Timelines Against Their Case Reports
abstract: arXiv:2609.13475v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing pipelines for clinical timeline extraction from case reports are evaluated using an expert reference and are limited by imperfect reference annotations and imprecise event alignment. We developed GAVEL, an LLM judge protocol that compares two timelines with the case report and returns a discrepancy type, verdict, and report passage for each difference. We evaluated the event matcher, reviewed 2,738 findings from GPT5.6sol and DeepSeek V3.2, ranked six LLM extractors and two human annotators, and tested GAVEL guided merging. True match rates were 60% immediately below and 48% immediately above the 0.10 cutoff. Manual review confirmed 89.4% and 88.6% of findings. Across 126 reports, merged timelines were preferred in 77.0% of comparisons (95% CI, 69.8 to 84.1%) and reduced discrepancies attributed to the evaluated timeline from 7.63 to 0.85 per report. translated_title: 提取时间线差异的有据裁决（GAVEL）：将临床时间线与其病例报告进行对比
translated_abstract: 现有的从病例报告中提取临床时间线的流程通常使用专家参考进行评估，但受限于不完美的参考标注和不精确的事件对齐。我们开发了GAVEL，这是一种LLM评判协议，它将两条时间线与病例报告进行对比，并为每处差异返回差异类型、判定结果和报告依据段落。我们评估了事件匹配器，审查了来自GPT5.6sol和DeepSeek V3.2的2,738项发现，对六个LLM提取器和两个人类标注者进行了排名，并测试了GAVEL引导的合并方法。在0.10截止阈值紧邻下方的真实匹配率为60%，紧邻上方为48%。人工审查确认了89.4%和88.6%的发现结果。在126份报告中，合并后的时间线在77.0%的对比中更受青睐（95%置信区间：69.8%至84.1%），并将归因于被评估时间线的差异从每份报告7.63个降至0.85个。GAVEL支持基于报告的比较和修订，而无需将任何一条时间线视为……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: GAVEL是一种以病例报告为依据的LLM评判协议，能够裁决不同方法提取的临床时间线之间的差异，显著降低差异数量，且合并后的时间线在大多数对比中表现更优。
en_tdlr: GAVEL is an LLM judge protocol that adjudicates discrepancies between extracted clinical timelines by grounding each comparison in the source case report, substantially reducing discrepancies and producing preferred merged timelines.
